hero.description: An international action week for volunteers, environmental experts and young leaders from across the Caspian region

about.heading: About the International Week
about.paragraph1: The «Caspian Sea Action Week» international action week is a platform for international cooperation that unites the efforts of Caspian littoral states. It works to raise environmental responsibility, support volunteer initiatives, exchange experience and best practices, and develop joint projects aimed at preserving the Caspian Sea ecosystem.
about.paragraph2: The goal is to strengthen international cooperation among Caspian littoral states, build the capacity of the volunteer movement, support joint initiatives to preserve the Caspian Sea ecosystem, and foster environmental responsibility and a sustainable ecological culture in society.

mangystau.heading: About Mangystau
mangystau.subheading: Where history and modern life meet
mangystau.regionParagraph1: A region in western Kazakhstan where distinctive nature and deep history meet. Located on the eastern coast of the Caspian Sea, it reflects the harmony of desert and sea, history and modern life.
mangystau.regionParagraph2: Mangystau is a sacred place that preserves traces of ancient civilizations. Necropolises with thousands of years of history, underground mosques and stone monuments are located here.
mangystau.regionParagraph3: Beket Ata, Shopan Ata, Sherkala, Torysh, Borankul and Bozzhyra have become spiritual and tourism symbols of the region.
mangystau.cityParagraph1: The administrative center of Mangystau Region and a modern, distinctive city on the Caspian Sea coast. Founded in the 1960s as an oil workers' city, Aktau has become an energy and tourism hub.
mangystau.cityParagraph2: The city stands out for its seafront, open sky and modern architecture. Culture and innovation develop side by side in Aktau, with youth forums, international meetings and festivals held here often.
mangystau.cityParagraph3: Developed infrastructure, an airport, hotels and modern public spaces create comfortable conditions for international participants.
mangystau.todayDescription: Today, Mangystau is a developed center of industry, transport and tourism. International connections are built across the sea, while the region's infrastructure and cultural life continue to renew year after year.
